answer: A strict intake gate acts as a digital haven by measuring computational exhaust and energy draw against a strict threshold. Just as a heavy bulkhead seals a hollow drift against toxic gas inflows, this cryptographic trap forces every rogue bot to burn measurable resources per identity. The resulting cost at the wharf prevents attackers from flooding the network cheaply, though sophisticated botnets can still bypass this check by exploiting unmonitored baseline thermal leakage.
